findings.passage: I support overturning Citizens United, banning congressional stock trading, and enforcing strong federal laws to protect voting rights.
findings.note: Campaign home page, undated. General support for strong federal voting-rights laws, no specifics on ID or citizenship.

findings.passage: Protecting the right to vote is crucial to a functioning democracy, and every citizen deserves a voice at the ballot. We have witnessed firsthand how decisions like LA v Callais dilute the voting power of Americans and leave millions disenfranchised. In Congress, I will support the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to secure voting rights for all Americans.
findings.note: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey answer submitted Oct 2, 2026. Says he would support the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act. Does not mention ID or citizenship proof.
